summary: The repository contains two high-severity security vulnerabilities: a hardcoded live API key [s1.f1] and a SQL injection flaw in the get_user function [s1.f2]. Additionally, there are medium-severity bugs including a zero-division error in the average function [s1.f3] and a bare except clause that masks errors [s2.f2]. A low-severity resource leak exists where a file handle is never closed [s1.f5].

findings.title: Hardcoded live API key
findings.detail: Live secret committed in source; anyone with repo access can use it.

findings.title: SQL injection in get_user
findings.detail: User input concatenated into SQL; attacker can read/modify data. Use parameterized query.

evidence.quote: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"

findings.title: Zero-division in average
findings.detail: average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError; called with empty list in main().

findings.title: Bare except hides errors
findings.detail: Bare except catches KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit and silently returns {} on any error, masking real failures.

findings.title: File handle never closed
findings.detail: open() in load_config is not closed; resource leak on repeated calls.
